title: Seared Sirloin with Roast Squash, Mushrooms & Caper Salsa Verde
description: Pan-seared sirloin over thyme-roasted butternut and chestnut mushrooms, finished with a garlic-free parsley-caper salsa verde.

ingredients.name: Beef sirloin or rump steak, ~3 cm thick (one ~360 g + one ~240 g)

steps.title: Temper the steaks
steps.text: Take the steaks out of the fridge, pat dry and season all over with 1 tsp salt. Leave at room temperature for 30 min while the squash roasts.

steps.title: Roast the squash
steps.text: Heat the oven to 220 °C (200 °C fan). Toss the squash with 1 tbsp olive oil, the thyme, chilli flakes and the remaining ½ tsp salt. Roast 15 min.

steps.title: Add the mushrooms and roast
steps.text: Add the mushrooms to the tray, toss with the squash and its oil, and roast another 20 min until the squash is caramelised at the edges.

steps.title: Make the salsa verde
steps.text: Finely chop the parsley, shallot and capers. Stir in 1.5 tbsp olive oil, the vinegar, Dijon, 1 tbsp water and black pepper.

steps.title: Sear the steaks
steps.text: Heat the remaining ½ tbsp olive oil in a heavy pan until smoking. Sear the steaks 4 min per side for medium (58–60 °C core); add 1 min per side if you prefer them more done.

steps.title: Rest the meat
steps.text: Rest the steaks on a board for 5 min. Toast the sourdough meanwhile.

steps.title: Slice and split
steps.text: Slice against the grain. Matthias: ≈360 g steak, about two-thirds of the squash and 60% of the mushrooms, plus the toast. Partner: ≈240 g steak and the rest of the veg. Spoon salsa verde over both, slightly more for Matthias.

notes: Peel and cube the whole butternut tonight: roast 900 g here and refrigerate the rest (~1.1 kg) for the soup. Swap the shallot for 2 spring onions if it's too sharp.
